description.value: Yet's Cafe claims to be Vancouver's first fresh fruit boba tea and juice shop, specializing in bubble teas, fresh fruit boba teas, and a range of international juice flavors. Located on Burrard Street, the shop emphasizes fresh, real-fruit ingredients and has drawn comparisons to Persian-style juice bars. However, the business's current status is uncertain, as the Wix site appears frozen at 2021 and a rebrand to 'Place2be Cafe' has been flagged.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 6m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 35m; stands (4 spaces) at 67m; stands (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 16 spaces.
